root_cause_clusters.RC_CIVIL_TIME: Site IANA zones and DST are stored but unused. Horizon and QC as-of arithmetic use naive UTC or a fixed offset.
root_cause_clusters.RC_RATING: Segment selection ignores stage bounds and effective dates; out-of-range silently extrapolates; reverse path always allowed.
root_cause_clusters.RC_QC_HOLD: Holds are recorded but do not block forecast publish; release is a no-op; duplicate holds accepted.
root_cause_clusters.RC_SERIES: Series publish last-writer-wins on (site,parameter,at); superseded observations still appear; digest ignores order.
root_cause_clusters.RC_JOURNAL: Usage opens/creates out files before parse; event_id is not a payload fence; replay reapplies from seq 0; sqlite commits before journal append.
root_cause_clusters.RC_FORECAST: Horizon uses wall minutes without site TZ; issued_at ignores as-of; held sites still emit forecast rows.
root_cause_clusters.RC_PUBLISH: Publish mixes warehouse prior-season rows into live series/forecast; health always ok.

causal_edges.why: Bad civil conversion shifts horizon_end.
Per-site tz errors change local lead math.
Grace config unused allows skewed as-of.
Wrong segment yields wrong value/unit pairing.
Illegal extrapolated points linger in series.
Wrong effective curve feeds wrong segments.
Duplicate obs keys produce duplicate series lines.
Superseded points poison digest.
Non-blocking holds leave held sites in forecast.
Broken release leaves hold semantics wrong.
Non-idempotent replay doubles series keys.
Full replay reintroduces duplicates.
Sqlite-before-journal forces unsafe catch-up paths.
Warehouse mix should force warehouse_untouched false.
Warehouse points change digest.
Forecast mix is also warehouse contamination.
Usage path creates out before validation.
Illegal reverse invents STAGE/FLOW confusion.
Phantom site curve bypasses effective windows.
Horizon bugs still emit rows for held sites when holds ignored.

do_not_inject: cmd/seed — seed writes consistent inherited journal+sqlite+checkpoint as if the clean system had run.
warehouse/prior_season.sqlite contents — keep a real prior season; defect is publish mixing.
config/hydro.json default_tz and grace values — must be correct so unused-config is discoverable.
docs/hydro-contract.md — complete-system rules; no module patch list or defect ids.
Correct site tz map in seed — defects are unused conversion, not wrong seeded tz strings.
grace_decision: Grace applies to forecast --as-of skew versus wall clock derived from journal head; no scheduled observation slots in v1.
organic_f2p_note: 25–30 F2P from: usage no-touch, event_id replay/conflict, catch-up, TZ/DST horizon, grace config, rating segment/range/effective/reverse, obs duplicate, series uniqueness/supersede, hold block/release/duplicate/site-missing, forecast horizon/as-of/held filter, warehouse isolation, health ok/digest/units.
